ma.cancelTimer()

Cancel the timer created by the current Mini Program and notify the developer through the success callback (minimum version: 25.9.0)

Supported only on iOS

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function when the interface is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure.
complete Function No Callback function when the interface invoking is complete (regardless of whether the invoking is successful)
object.success
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String cancelTimer: ok
object.fail
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message

Sample Code

ma.cancelTimer({
    success: (res) => {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'cancelTimer success',
            content: JSON.stringify(res),
            showCancel: false
        })
    },
    fail: (res) => {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'cancelTimer fail',
            content: JSON.stringify(res),
            showCancel: false
        })
    }
})
